genotype_to_drug_rule: Under primary reading pheno_default, calls R when ResFinder v4 phenotype translation marks amr_resistant=true combining acquired genes (>=90% identity, >=60% coverage) and species PointFinder mutations; absent phenotype entries produce no_call.

i_handling.description: ResFinder v4 phenotype tables emit binary resistant/susceptible flags without I; any I token is counted separately and never mapped to S.
